fact: At its meeting of 3 June 2024 the Authority examined 36 forms (12 declarations, 24 authorisation requests) and took named decisions on controllers' files, e.g. deferring decision on two declarations; 91 forms were received at the single window between 2 and 6 June 2024, 13 accepted and 78 suspended.
title: اجتماع 11 جوان 2024
